add_tensorboard_default_configs: add default tensorboard configuration settings to a detectron2 config node for visualization during training and evaluation
visualize_train_input: create a visualization of a training input image with ground truth boxes masks and keypoints overlaid
visualize_test_output: build a visualization of model test output showing predicted instance panoptic or semantic segmentation results
visualize_dataset_dict: create a visualization of a dataset dictionary entry using the dataset mapper and metadata catalog
DataLoaderVisWrapper: wrap a data loader to periodically write training input visualizations to tensorboard at a configured frequency
